moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Aaron Donald will not travel to Australia and is inactive for Rams opener, easing his return workload.
moments.why: Men 25‑45 are buzzing about this delayed comeback from an NFL legend—inactive status fuels tradeoffs and Rams depth talk.

moments.author: Google DeepMind
moments.quote: Introducing AlphaGenome Atlas: a 1‑petabyte map predicting effects of all 9B possible DNA letter changes.
moments.why: A massive AI‑bio drop—guys into tech and science are hyped about its magnitude and impact.

moments.quote: After a cont. win, Frances Tiafoe comforts a tearful Alex Michelsen in a touching post‑match moment.

moments.author: MLBNearHR
moments.quote: Rafael Devers hit a “reverse unicorn”—went for 106.7 mph off the bat but ended up a double at Oracle (would’ve been HR in 29/30 parks).
moments.why: A hilarious & nerdy stat that fans — especially into baseball metrics — can't stop sharing.
